subject: Safety padding reserve request — low-latency telemetry pilot
messages:
From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Safety padding reserve request — low-latency telemetry pilot

Hi Laura / Marissa —

We have a pilot kickoff with Nova Clinic next Tuesday for their real-time telemetry ingestion and inference (edge-to-cloud latencies must stay under 120ms P95). Their initial tests show bursty spikes when sensors sync; to avoid noisy cold-starts and SLA risks, Sophie has asked if we can provide a temporary "safety padding" reservation on a Dedicated GPU slice for the first 3 weeks of the pilot.

Quick ask: can we reserve a single A10G slice (4 GPUs) in us-west for the pilot window 2028-04-16 → 2028-05-06, with autoscaling set to disabled for the first 48 hours of each day (local batch windows) and a soft-preemption policy (30m grace) enabled?

Rationale:
- Predictable latency during initial tuning and telemetry smoothing.
- Reduce noisy doubles/evictions that ruin the demo and risk the pilot.
- Helps surface model/kv-cache warmup issues without competing interference.

I've attached the pilot plan and a short forecast of expected GPU token throughput. If this needs approvals (reserved capacity commit or commercial exception), flag here and I can route.

Attachments: telemetry_pilot_plan_v1.pdf, forecast_gpu_usage.csv

Thanks,
Aditya
Aditya Rao
Sales Lead, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Safety padding reserve request — low-latency telemetry pilot

Aditya —

Thanks for the context. A few operational notes from my side:
- We can provision a temporary A10G slice for the requested window but need exact daily on/off windows for autoscale to implement the "disabled for first 48 hours of each day" detail you mentioned — do you mean local startup windows (e.g., 00:00–48:00 from start) or repeated twice-a-day 48-hour blocks?
- Soft-preemption with 30m grace is reasonable; ops will add a monitoring hook to trigger failover to hosted fallback if we see queue blowups.
- We need sign-off from Product for the SLA exception and Finance for short-term billing adjustments (we can apply a one-month pro-rated reserved charge or bill as burst usage).

Can you confirm the exact timeline and whether Nova is comfortable with a pro-rated reserved fee? If yes, I'll loop in finance and create a short approval ticket.

Laura Bennett
Head of Dedicated Operations
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sophie Miller <sophie@novaclinic.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Apr 2028 12:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Safety padding reserve request — low-latency telemetry pilot

Laura — thanks. Clarifications below, copied Sophie for transparency.

- Timeline: reserve 2028-04-16 00:00 PT → 2028-05-06 23:59 PT.
- Autoscale: disable autoscaling for the first 48 hours after the pilot slice is provisioned (i.e., 2028-04-16 00:00 PT → 2028-04-18 23:59 PT) to let the team tune caching and model warmup. After that, enable autoscale with limited burst to +1 GPU and strict CPU/GPU throttling.
- Billing: Nova is fine with a short pro-rated reserved fee for the three-week window; Sophie confirms.

Sophie — can you confirm the dates above and that the pro-rated billing is acceptable?

Thanks,
Aditya

From: Sophie Miller <sophie@novaclinic.com>
To: aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Apr 2028 08:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Safety padding reserve request — low-latency telemetry pilot

Hi all —

Confirmed. Nova Clinic approves the reserve window 2028-04-16 → 2028-05-06 and the 48-hour cold-start tuning window with autoscale disabled. We also accept a pro-rated reserved fee for the pilot; please send the invoice details.

A couple of asks from our infra team:
- Can you tag the slice with "nova-telemetry-pilot" and include a short list of expected topologies (batch size, perf tokens/sec)? I attached a short CSV with our expected ingress pattern.
- If soft-preemption occurs, please notify our ops mailing list (ops-planning@novaclinic.com) immediately so we can pause upstream retries.

Attachments: forecast_gpu_usage.csv

Best,
Sophie Miller
Director, Cloud Integrations
Nova Clinic

From: marissa_cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sophie Miller <sophie@novaclinic.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Safety padding reserve request — low-latency telemetry pilot

All —

Operational plan and approvals in place. Summary of final decisions:
- Provision: 1x A10G slice (4 GPUs) in us-west from 2028-04-16 00:00 PT → 2028-05-06 23:59 PT.
- Autoscale behavior: disabled for the initial 48 hours (2028-04-16 → 2028-04-18) then enabled with max +1 GPU burst and strict throttling.
- Preemption: soft-preemption with 30m eviction grace; on preemption we will notify ops-planning@novaclinic.com and failover to hosted fallback if latency degrades.
- Billing: pro-rated reserved charge; Finance ticket created (see HubSpot DEAL-7843).

Actions:
- Laura: please create the reservation request and tag the slice "nova-telemetry-pilot".
- Dev: add the KV-cache warmup hook and a tracing span that reports first-token latency in the runbook.
- Aditya: send Sophie the invoice stub and update the mutual action plan attached to the HubSpot deal.

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.docx

I'll monitor during the first 72 hours and loop in infra on any anomalies.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Dedicated GTM
Redwood Inference
